# Lines that start a process or name a script interpreter, which privacy-check.py processes
# allows, as `<path>: <token>`. A hit is allowed when its file equals <path> and the line
# contains <token>. Only two files may start a process, and one more may name osascript.
#
# The permission reset runs /usr/bin/tccutil to reset holzBar's own grants.
holzBar/Permissions/Permission.swift: Process()
# The script runner starts the one file the user approved, configured only from the launch
# plan (no shell, no arguments, a fixed environment); see SECURITY.md, T-11-H3 and T-11-H4.
holzBar/MenuBar/Automation/ScriptRunner.swift: Process()
# The launch plan names /usr/bin/osascript to run an AppleScript file with its own path.
holzBar/Core/ScriptLaunch.swift: "/usr/bin/osascript"
